title: Authenticate and land on the home feed
description: A user can log in with valid credentials and reach the main news feed after authentication.

Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the home feed is displayed
Verify categories are available

Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /login

Verify the user remains authenticated
